- (v) Separate interviews.For direct recruitment against reserved vacancies, separate interviews will be held for SC/ST candidates so that they are not adjudged along with general candidates. - Order 11, Section 2.
- (vi) In respect of candidates selected by relaxed standards, special training programme including in-service training should be given to enable them to come up to the standards of other candidates.
